A rare type of '''flower''' was widely banned during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and could be dried, ground and ingested for medicinal purposes, prompting a [[Unidentified pharmaceutical company|pharmaceutical company]] to try and acquire the [[Flower/Legends|flower]] on [[Durace]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|An Unusual Bloom}}</ref>
